label: Ink
help: Left empty it follows the theme foreground, so the signature shows up in light and dark alike; pick a colour to pin it.

label: Pen width
help: Stroke thickness, in the 1200 × 400 drawing frame.

label: Smoothing
help: 0 keeps the line exactly as recorded. Above 0 the corners are rounded off, which takes the jitter out of a mouse-drawn signature.

label: Trim to the ink
help: Tighten the view to what you drew, plus a small margin, so the signature fills the frame instead of floating in the middle of it.

label: Stroke data
help: The signature itself, as one SVG path per stroke. The pad writes this for you - every stroke you draw, undo or clear is one edit here, so it rides undo, share links and saves. Long signatures make long links: the pad drops points closer than a few units apart to keep them short, and past a few hundred strokes a link gets unwieldy.
